result.title: BRICE: Brain-inspired Recurrent Illusory Contour Encoder for Point Cloud Completion
result.summary: Mainstream point cloud completion methods are unanimously based on deep learning architectures. On one hand, these methods tend to repetitively stacking attention modules to enhance network performance, which drifts away from the neat design of unified and interpret-able networks; on the other hand, nearly all existing architectures rely solely on feed-forward connections to propagate information, neglecting feedback from deeper layers. The recurrent neural architecture, formed by feedforward-feedback loops, have shown its ability to generate Illusory Contours (ICs) in the V1 brain region of mammals; and ICs are essentially a completion mechanism of the brain for visual information. Motivated by this, we design a Brain-inspired Recurrent Illusory Contour Encoder (BRICE) to "imagine" what is missing in the incomplete 3D point clouds. Building upon the foundation model of Predictive Coding (PC), the plug-and-play nature enables BRICE to be seamlessly integrated into mainstream point cloud completion baselines. Experimental results show that BRICE can enhance various completion baselines on different 3D datasets such as MVP2K, PCN, and PlantPCom. Our code: Https://github.com/wangyunlei-wyl/BRICE.

AI.brief_summary: 提出脑启发的循环错觉轮廓编码器 BRICE，基于预测编码（PC）基础模型构造前馈-反馈循环，为不完整 3D 点云「想象」缺失部分，可即插即用地增强多种点云补全基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用前馈-反馈循环与预测编码迭代更新内部表征以补全缺失视觉信息的做法，可能为 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态更新、视觉细节保留与信息坍缩问题提供方法线索；但任务是 3D 点云补全而非多模态推理，迁移可行性有待核查。
